name: Primitive Survival
description: Fundamental knowledge of stone shaping and rough timber crafting.

name: Carpentry & Joinery
description: Advanced timber shaping into fortified palisades and reinforced structures.

name: Stone Masonry
description: Heft rough stone blocks into defensive stone walls and thermal kilns.

name: Herbal Medicine
description: Distill curative compounds from wild meadow herbs to treat bleeding.

name: Charcoal & Kilns
description: Utilize dense anthracite coal and charcoal kilns for high-temp smelting.

name: Bronze Metallurgy
description: Smelt copper and alloy metals to forge durable bronze spears.

name: Hunting Archery
description: Fashion curved wooden hunting bows and sharp arrows for long-range combat.

name: Iron Ore Smelting
description: Melt raw iron ore in stone furnaces to produce pure iron ingots.

name: Iron Blade Forging
description: Hammer glowing iron ingots into sharp swords, daggers and spike perimeter traps.

name: Mechanical Crossbows
description: Assemble iron-reinforced composite crossbows with heavy penetrating force.

name: Chainmail Weaving
description: Link hundreds of iron rings into flexible chainmail coifs and hauberks.

name: Heavy War Hammers
description: Forge devastating two-handed war hammers and heavy iron vault storage.
